channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Lula não ganha mais eleitores no Nordeste
item.description: Lula did not gain voters in the Northeast at the start of the second round, maintaining 63.8% of vote intentions according to Datafolha. Flávio Bolsonaro increased from 30.9% to 36.6%, gaining ground in the PT stronghold. The poll indicates consolidation of Lula's leadership in the region, but with progress by his opponent.

item.title: Quem é Cavala, a dona de bordel eleita deputada federal com quase 77 mil votos
item.description: Isa Jane Marcondes Nantes, known as 'Cavala', a 46-year-old businesswoman from the Republicans party, was elected federal congresswoman for Mato Grosso do Sul in the 2026 elections with 76,956 votes, becoming the 7th most-voted parliamentarian in the state. Her controversial background involving brothels and sex work has sparked debates about morality and sexuality in Brazilian politics.

item.title: Veja onde assistir Fluminense x Coritiba ao vivo nesta quinta-feira (08)
item.description: Fluminense and Coritiba face off in the 29th round of the 2026 Brazilian Championship at 9:30 PM at Maracanã in Rio de Janeiro. The match is part of the national league and highlights key moments in Brazilian football.

item.title: Brasileiras buscam o Itamaraty após serem "caçadas" por deputado da Polônia
item.description: Two Brazilian women were targeted by Polish EU lawmaker Dominik Tarczyński after displaying PT symbols during voting in Poland. The Brazilian Foreign Ministry confirmed consular support to the citizens, while Tarczyński accused them of violating Polish laws against communism. The incident raised concerns about freedom of expression and political symbolism abroad.

item.title: Cristiano Zanin nega recurso de Paes e Ruas fica mais próximo do Palácio da Guanabara
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Cristiano Zanin rejected the appeal filed by Eduardo Paes' defense to suspend the TSE decision that annulled Anthony Garotinho's votes in the Rio de Janeiro gubernatorial election. As a result, Douglas Ruas (PL) moves closer to victory, and the Rio Electoral Court will recount the votes. The decision found insufficient procedural requirements for suspension, as the internal appeals at the TSE had not yet been exhausted.

item.title: Pavanato e Boulos trocam ofensas em aeroporto de Brasília
item.description: Elected federal deputy Lucas Pavanato (PL) released a video showing a heated exchange of insults with Minister Guilherme Boulos (PSOL) at Brasília International Airport. The recording contains profanities and political provocations, with both using aggressive language. The incident occurs amid tensions surrounding the 2026 second-round election campaign.

item.title: Governo projeta R$ 161 bi para portos, aeroportos e hidrovias até 2030
item.description: The federal government projects R$161.5 billion in investments for ports, airports, and inland waterways between 2027 and 2030. The plan aims to ensure continuity of infrastructure projects for the next administration, including the renegotiation of Viracopos Airport and the concession of TECON 10 at the Port of Santos.

item.title: Ato a favor de Lula em SP tem momentos de confusão
item.description: A pro-Lula rally in São Paulo gathered students from Mackenzie, USP, and PUC-SP, clashing with supporters of Flávio Bolsonaro. Military Police prevented the tension from escalating into physical attacks.

item.title: Servidores do TSE são alvo de ataques nas redes e PF é acionada para investigar
item.description: TSE servers are targeted by social media attacks, with around 30 thousand posts identified, including misinformation and threats. The Federal Police was tasked with investigating, and the TSE stated that the attacks may constitute crimes. Servers and their families receive security reinforcement and psychological support.

item.title: 'Odeio branco': direita resgata supostas postagens antigas de petista mais votada em MG, que cita fake news e aciona TSE
item.description: Bolsonaro-aligned lawmakers resurface alleged old posts by elected lawmaker Ana Elisa Santos (PT), accusing her of racist statements; she denies the claims and threatens legal action at the TSE over fake news. The episode underscores the polarized 2026 election landscape, with Lula strengthening ties to younger lawmakers while facing criticism over the effectiveness of digital campaigning. Ana Elisa, the most-voted parliamentarian in Minas Gerais history, joins the new PT generation supporting Lula in the runoff against the PL.

item.title: Cury, Republicanos e terceira via: como Flávio amplia vantagem sobre Lula
item.description: Augusto Cury announced support for Flávio Bolsonaro after the senator signed a public commitment with the writer's proposals, including the end of presidential re-election. The Republicanos also partnered with the PL candidate, and the PSDB released its affiliates, expanding Flávio's lead over Lula according to Datafolha polling.

item.title: Lobista do caso INSS apoia Kátia Abreu e expõe racha em torno de Janja
item.description: Former senator Kátia Abreu, now in PT, criticized Janja's presence in Lula's campaign and advocated for greater protagonism for Geraldo Alckmin. Lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger, investigated in the INSS scandal, endorsed the criticism in a video. The case reveals internal cracks within PT.

item.title: Sem citar Ruas, Paes reconhece derrota na disputa pelo governo do Rio: 'A eleição termina'
item.description: Eduardo Paes (PSD) acknowledged defeat after the STF rejected a appeal to overturn the TSE decision, ending the Rio gubernatorial election without a runoff. Douglas Ruas (PL) was elected governor of the state.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro recebe apoio de governadores eleitos e Cury
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) received support from 14 elected state governors in Brasília, including Sergio Moro (PR) and Douglas Ruas (RJ), plus Augusto Cury after signing a commitment charter. In a live stream echoing Jair Bolsonaro's style, Flávio denied Bolsa Família cuts and promised pension increases above inflation.

item.title: Lula celebra avanço do fim da 6x1 e defende investimento público
item.description: Lula celebrated progress toward ending the 6x1 work scale in the Senate and defended public infrastructure investments, criticizing austerity measures proposed by opponents. He reaffirmed commitment to securing two days off without wage cuts.

item.title: Boulos e Pavanato trocam xingamentos ao se encontrarem em aeroporto
item.description: The Chief of Staff of the Presidency, Guilherme Boulos (PSol), exchanged insults with federal deputy-elect Lucas Pavanato (PL) at a Brasília airport. The confrontation included mutual offenses, references to Pavanato's votes, and criticisms of President Lula, reflecting the political polarization climate.

item.title: Flávio é recebido por arcebispo de Brasília e ganha imagem de Nossa Senhora
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro met with the archbishop of Brasília and received an image of Our Lady of Aparecida. In the second round, he secured backing from União Brasil, PP, Novo, and Republicanos, diverging from prior neutrality.

item.title: Haddad assume campanha de Lula em SP e minimiza desvantagem
item.description: Fernando Haddad launched Lula's campaign in São Paulo, distributing leaflets and mobilizing supporters on Paulista Avenue. During the event, Haddad downplayed PT's electoral disadvantage, emphasizing the importance of grassroots organizing in Brazil's largest city. This effort is part of the campaign's ground strategy for the runoff.

item.title: Grupo de dança de crianças africanas que fez vídeo pró-Flávio Bolsonaro promete devolver criptomoedas recebidas por apoio
item.description: The Hypers Kids Africa dance group from Uganda announced the return of 120 million $B22 tokens received for a video supporting Flávio Bolsonaro, following negative public reaction. The young dancers removed the content and stated they had no intention of political involvement, emphasizing their mission of entertainment and community support. The partnership was conducted without any contact with campaigns or political parties.

item.title: Token B22: o que a lei eleitoral diz sobre a cripto pró-Flávio
item.description: A crypto token named B22 was launched in support of Flávio Bolsonaro, featuring videos of children in Uganda and offering rewards for sharing content. Flávio's electoral campaign announced legal action to shut down the site. Brazilian electoral law regulates digital campaigns and prohibits indirect voting incentives.

item.title: Centrão pulou no barco de Flávio, mas é cedo para o ‘já ganhou’
item.description: After the first round, the Centrão backed Flávio Bolsonaro, but the Datafolha poll revealed a technical tie, keeping victory uncertain. Lula's campaign, deemed his weakest since 1989, seeks to revitalize its base with change proposals, while Flávio projects a five-year term and gains support from former opponents.

item.title: Ato a favor de Lula em SP tem momentos de tensão entre estudantes petistas e bolsonaristas
item.description: Pro-Lula rally in São Paulo saw clashes between supporters of the left-wing candidate and Flávio Bolsonaro, with insults exchanged and police intervention. The demonstration was organized by Mackenzie students protesting the university's ban on partisan activities.

item.title: Proposta de Flávio reabre brecha à sonegação e mexe na reforma tributária
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign proposes abolishing split payment, a tax mechanism aimed at reducing evasion, but critics warn it could harm government revenue. The pledge reignites debates on taxation and anti-corruption enforcement.

item.title: "Bets viraram uma desgraça para o povo pobre", afirma Lula
item.description: Lula criticized online sports betting, calling it a 'disaster for the poor' and stating the government will not allow basic need money to be used for bets. He also dismissed football clubs' claims that the sport will die without online betting revenue.

item.title: Zanin nega recurso de Paes, e Douglas Ruas deve ser declarado eleito no Rio
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Cristiano Zanin rejected Eduardo Paes' appeal to annul Douglas Ruas' (PL) election in Rio de Janeiro. The ruling allows vote recounting, excluding Anthony Garotinho's votes, which should elect Ruas in the first round.

item.title: Lula chama ‘tesouraço’ de Flávio de “aberração”
item.description: President Lula labeled Senator Flávio Bolsonaro's proposed 'budget scissor' measure an 'aberration,' warning that spending cuts could harm the poorest Brazilians. The remarks were made in a public address emphasizing social concerns.

item.title: "22 quer você morto": cartaz na UnB mostra Flávio de Hitler; MP é acionado
item.description: Anonymous posters at UnB feature Flávio Bolsonaro with Nazi imagery and misleading accusations, prompting condemnation from lawmaker Victor Jansen (PL-DF), who filed a complaint with the federal prosecutor to investigate hate and defamation crimes.

item.title: Vídeos de Lula viralizam, mas voto não vem. O que explica?
item.description: Although Lula's videos go viral on social media, the first PoderData/Aya survey after the first round shows Flávio Bolsonaro leading with 53% of valid votes against Lula's 47%. Duda Teixeira and Carlos Graieb discuss the herd effect, the PT's reaction, and Lula's new strategy to win over voters.

item.title: Los sondeos dan a Flávio Bolsonaro una ventaja de cuatro puntos frente a Lula en la segunda vuelta
item.description: A new Datafolha poll shows Flávio Bolsonaro leading with 52% of valid votes in a hypothetical runoff against Lula, who obtains 48%. The four-point advantage is outside the margin of error, signaling a favorable scenario for the PL candidate.

item.title: Kassio aciona PF após ataques e ameaças a servidores da Justiça Eleitoral
item.description: TSE President Kassio Nunes Marques requested the Federal Police to investigate attacks and threats against electoral justice servers and their families, following the identification of 30,000 social media posts involving disinformation and hate speech. The court also reported irregular content to platforms like X and Meta and provided security and psychological support. The Public Ministry also sought the removal of unlawful content.

item.title: Zanin nega recurso de Paes ao STF sobre anulação de votos de Garotinho ao Governo do RJ
item.description: STF minister Cristiano Zanin rejected the appeal filed by Eduardo Paes' coalition against the annulment of votes for Anthony Garotinho in the Rio de Janeiro gubernatorial race. The ruling upholds the TSE's decision regarding electoral irregularities involving the Republican candidate.

item.title: Rua Maria Antônia é fechada após briga entre apoiadores de Lula e Flávio
item.description: Maria Antônia street in São Paulo was closed by military police after a clash between supporters of Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro during a pro-Lula rally near the Presbyterian Mackenzie University, which banned political gatherings on campus. The university's administration prohibited the events after an unauthorized assembly was called. The rally featured appearances by figures such as Guilherme Boulos and Erika Hilton.

item.title: Zanin barra pedido de Paes para suspender decisão do TSE e realizar 2º turno no Rio
item.description: Supreme Court justice Cristiano Zanin rejected Eduardo Paes' appeal to suspend a TSE decision annulling Anthony Garotinho's votes, allowing vote recount that may change the election outcome in favor of Douglas Ruas.

item.title: Zanin nega pedido de Paes para suspender decisão do TSE que deve dar vitória a Douglas Ruas no Rio
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Cristiano Zanin rejected Rio Mayor Eduardo Paes' request to suspend a TSE ruling that awards victory to Douglas Ruas by excluding Anthony Garotinho's votes. As result, Ruas exceeds 50% of valid votes and is set to win in the first round, with vote recount scheduled for Saturday by the Rio Electoral Court.

item.title: Zanin nega pedido de Paes contra anulação de votos de Garotinho
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Cristiano Zanin rejected the request from Eduardo Paes' coalition to suspend the annulment of Anthony Garotinho's votes, stating that the extraordinary appeal had not yet been filed. The TSE voted 5 to 2 to invalidate Garotinho's votes, potentially leading to Douglas Ruas winning in the first round.

item.title: Sambistas convocam ato na Lapa em apoio a Lula
item.description: Samba artists and Rio cultural figures hold a pro-Lula rally in Lapa on October 12. The event features personalities like Teresa Cristina, Neguinho da Beija-Flor, and samba school baterias.

item.title: Hugo Motta “vai me ajudar a ganhar”, afirma Lula após encontro
item.description: President Lula claimed that Hugo Motta will help him win the 2026 election after a 45-minute meeting at Alvorada Palace. Despite Center-wing support for Flávio Bolsonaro, Lula emphasized positive dialogue with the Chamber president. Motta seeks reelection with Lula's backing.

item.title: TSE aciona PF para investigar ataques e ameaças a servidores da Justiça Eleitoral
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court filed a complaint with the Federal Police and the Public Ministry to investigate attacks and threats against Justice Electoral servers on social media. Approximately 30,000 posts were recorded containing misinformation, improper exposure of personal data, and hate speech. The TSE also notified platforms X and Meta to remove the irregular content and ensured protection for servers and their families.

item.title: Com megafone, Lula convoca moradores do DF para caminhada em Ceilândia
item.description: Lula used a megaphone to invite DF residents to a campaign walk with Leandro Grass in Ceilândia, scheduled for this Friday. The event is part of the race between Grass (PT) and Celina Leão (PP) in the DF runoff election on October 25th. A Datafolha poll shows Celina leading with 55% and Grass at 37%.

item.title: Alckmin faz campanha para Lula na periferia de SP e destaca abstenção alta no 1º turno
item.description: Alckmin campaigned in Paraisópolis, São Paulo, supporting Lula and emphasizing high voter abstention in the first round. He met with community leaders and residents backing the presidential re-election.

item.title: Juíza contraria Lula, libera Stake, mas deixa pagamentos em aberto
item.description: A federal judge authorized Stake to resume operations in Brazil, contradicting the ban imposed by President Lula, but left payment processing in question since financial institutions are not directly required to restore transactions. The ruling is partial and does not affect other betting houses, as the legal dispute advances ahead of the scheduled withdrawal of player balances.

item.title: União Popular (UP), de Samara Martins, declara apoio a Lula no 2º turno
item.description: The União Popular (UP), the party of Samara Martins, officially announced support for Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) in the second round of the presidential election, directing its base toward the candidacy against Flávio Bolsonaro (PL). The decision was made by the party's national executive, which also announced street mobilizations during the campaign, with the slogan 'Vote 13'. Samara Martins received 122,911 votes in the first round, equivalent to 0.10% of valid votes.

item.title: Servidores do TSE são vítimas de ameaças na internet e tribunal pede investigação da PF
item.description: The TSE reinforced security for servers and relatives threatened by disinformation on social media following false fraud accusations. The court requested Federal Police investigation and communications to social networks to combat misinformation. The wave of threats was detected after the first round, with profiles spreading unfounded theories about alleged vote manipulation.

item.title: Lula volta a provocar Flávio sobre PEC da 6x1: "Pare de inventar lorota"
item.description: Lula challenged Flávio Bolsonaro over the PEC ending the 6x1 workweek, demanding a vote and accusing him of inventing 'fluff'. The issue became a priority in the final stretch of the campaign, with the government pushing to approve the shorter workweek before the elections. Flávio opposes the bill and prefers an hourly regime.

item.title: Coligação de Lula pede apuração de criptomoedas por posts pró-Flávio
item.description: Lula's coalition requested an investigation by the Electoral Prosecutor's Office into cryptocurrency distributions in exchange for favorable posts about Flávio Bolsonaro. The Brazil 22 Token project offers B22 tokens to those who promote the candidacy, raising suspicions of paid election advertising and vote buying.

item.title: Flávio não vai reduzir os pisos do orçamento da saúde e educação, diz campanha
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign states there will be no cuts to pensions, minimum wage, or constitutional floors for health and education. Despite this, the candidate keeps the promise to cut R$200 billion from the budget without detailing how. His stance against traditional fiscal reforms sparks controversy among economists.

item.title: Prefeito “tiktoker” de Florianópolis grava vídeo para campanha de Celina
item.description: The mayor of Florianópolis, Topázio Neto, known for his creative social media presence, participated in recordings for the re-election campaign of the governor of the Federal District, Celina Leão, in the second round of elections. The collaboration follows Celina's appointment of Thiago Peixoto, former municipal education secretary of Florianópolis, to head the Education Secretariat of the DF.

item.title: Paes vai ao STF para barrar anulação dos votos de Garotinho
item.description: The coalition of Eduardo Paes (PSD) appealed to the STF to suspend the annulment of votes for Anthony Garotinho (Republicanos), decided by the TSE, which paved the way for Douglas Ruas (PL) to be elected in the first round of the Rio de Janeiro elections. The TSE ordered a recount of votes, excluding those of Garotinho, so that Ruas exceeds 50% of valid votes.

item.title: Presidente do Novo atribui derrota de Zema a voto útil
item.description: The president of Novo, Eduardo Ribeiro, attributed Romeu Zema's defeat in the presidential election to a strong migration of votes to Flávio Bolsonaro in the first round, explaining that right-wing voters anticipated their support for the PL candidate to prevent the PT from winning. Ribeiro noted that Zema was disadvantaged by competing in the same voter segment as Flávio, but emphasized that the poor performance does not diminish the former governor's prestige.

item.title: “Vamos recorrer até o fim”, diz presidente do Novo sobre Deltan
item.description: Eduardo Ribeiro, president of Novo, said the party will appeal to the Supreme Federal Court if the Electoral Superior Court upholds the rejection of Deltan Dallagnol's candidacy, elected senator from Paraná. Minister Floriano de Azevedo Marques deemed Dallagnol ineligible for 8 years for leaving the Federal Prosecutor's Office while under disciplinary procedures. The decision was suspended by TSE President Kassio Nunes Marques, and Dallagnol's votes were counted.
